record.question: Which one of the following statements regarding AKI ( Acute Kidney Injury ) is false?
options: Increase in serum creatinine >0.3gm/dl within 48 hours
Increase in serum creatinine to >1.5 times the presumed baseline value within prior 7 days
Decrease in urine output to <0.5ml/Kg/hour for 6 hours
record.explanation: Official final key: D — Protein-creatinine ratio >3.5. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 11, printed Q29. The key selects the protein-creatinine-ratio statement. The source also misprints creatinine units as gm/dl rather than mg/dL; retain that visible defect rather than endorsing the unit.
